label.fa: HIV-1 (رژیم کامل) — ≥۲۵ kg: یک قرص ۵۰/۲۰۰/۲۵ mg روزانه؛ ۱۴ تا <۲۵ kg: یک قرص ۳۰/۱۲۰/۱۵ mg
label.en: HIV-1 (complete regimen) — ≥25 kg: one 50/200/25 mg tablet daily; 14–<25 kg: one 30/120/15 mg tablet

reason.fa: یک قرص یک بار در روز با یا بدون غذا؛ ClCr ۳۰ و بالاتر. ClCr ۱۵ تا <۳۰ یا ESRD بدون دیالیز مزمن و نارسایی شدید کبد توصیه نمی‌شود.
reason.en: One tablet once daily with or without food; CrCl ≥30. Not recommended at CrCl 15–<30, ESRD not on chronic haemodialysis, or severe hepatic impairment.

text.fa: هشدار جعبه‌ای: تشدید شدید هپاتیت B پس از قطع در عفونت همزمان HBV — پایش کبد چند ماه.
text.en: Boxed warning: severe acute exacerbation of hepatitis B after discontinuation in HBV co-infection — monitor the liver for several months.

text.fa: برچسب: داده‌های مشاهده‌ای و رجیستری خطر دارویی نقص مادرزادی بزرگ، سقط یا پیامد بد را ثابت نکرده‌اند.
text.en: Label: observational and registry data have not established a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage or adverse outcomes.

pregnancy.quote: Available data from observational studies and the APR with BIC, FTC and TAF use during pregnancy have not established a drug-associated risk of major birth defects, miscarriage or other adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary Data from the published literature report the presence of BIC, FTC, TAF, and tenofovir in human milk.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: The safety and effectiveness of BIKTARVY have been established as a complete regimen for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) infection in pediatric patients weighing at least 14 kg: who have no antiretroviral treatment history, or with an antiretroviral treatment history and not virologically …

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Clinical trials in virologically-suppressed participants (Trials 4449, 1844, and 1878) included 111 participants aged 65 years and over who received BIKTARVY, including 86 patients from an open-label, single-arm trial of participants aged 65 years and over who were switched from their previous antiretroviral regimen …
